invariants.rationale: AssetManager is required for AtlasResolver and thus must not be null.
getAtlasFileHandle(tmjFile) and loadTiledMap(tmjFile, ...) require tmjFile to be non-null.
The fileName is used to reference the map being loaded and is likely required by convention.
Parameter is passed to loadTiledMap and likely required; passing null could cause errors.
The atlasHandle, derived from tmjFile, must be non-null for further processing in the method.
